I am planting beans on this small plot because legumes do not need much fertilizer — they fix their own nitrogen in the soil. I cannot afford chemical fertilizer for beans when my maize plot needs it more, but I will spread some manure from my goats to help the soil. I will use seeds I saved from last season because improved bean seed is expensive and hard to find here in Dedza. My daughter and I will do most of the weeding ourselves; I only hire help for a few days during planting if the rains come hard.
